page: Microsoft Azure F16amds_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Famdsv7 family. It features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor operating at a high base frequency of 4.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of a 1890 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage.

In performance evaluations, the F16amds_v7 demonstrates top-tier single-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core performance and bzip3 single-threaded decompression scoring in the top 10% of tested servers. Multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU scores, falls within the average range. Memory bandwidth and database operations also register average performance. However, single-threaded gzip compression and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression show strong results in the top 25%. For lightweight machine learning tasks, the instance achieves top-tier text generation speeds of 420.78 tokens per second on small 135M models, though performance scales down to average levels for larger 7B and 70B models.

From a resource density perspective, the F16amds_v7 offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that require dedicated CPU execution without hyperthreading. The inclusion of a fast, high-capacity local NVMe SSD reduces the need for external storage attachments for temporary data. This hardware profile is highly suitable for memory-intensive applications, relational databases, caching layers like Redis, data decompression pipelines, and lightweight LLM inference tasks.
